name: Kumakawa Yuki
source:
So that she can be more sociable her husband recommended that she take yoga lessons.
Her relationship with her husband is very good, however her sexual appetite is vigorous and he doesn't fully satisfy her. Because of that she often masturbates on the bedside after he husband has fallen asleep.

She is still lactating because she has recently given birth to her son, Toshiya.
